Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in League City, Texas, checking my mirror and signaling before I moved
over. As I started to merge, the car in the next lane came up alongside me and our side panels made contact. Neither
of us swerved far, but the impact pushed my vehicle toawrd the median before I could correct. I pulled onto the
shoulder and stayed in my car until the other driver stopped. I have described what happened the same way each
time I have spoken about it, to the other driver, to the officer on scene, and to my insurer. I am the named driver on
this policy and was operating my own vehicle at the time. The impact jolted my neck, and I have since been treated
for a neck strain. I am filing this claim so the damage to my vehicle and my medical costs can be reviewed.
